drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long decay providing a sub-bass rumble. A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes with a resonant filter sweep. A high-pitched, dissonant industrial alarm sound repeats every four bars. The percussion includes a sharp, white-noise snare on the backbeat and a constant, un-swung closed hi-hat on every eighth note. A low-frequency sawtooth bassline enters mid-track, playing a syncopated two-note pattern. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing a cold, mechanical texture. 135 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of D minor.

bass.tags: Pop-rock with a driving, upbeat tempo. The arrangement features a bright, overdriven electric guitar playing a rhythmic eighth-note pattern, a clean electric bass guitar, and a standard drum kit with a prominent snare and hi-hat. A melodic synthesizer lead enters during the instrumental breaks. The track is in the key of G Major with a 4/4 time signature at 128 BPM. The production is clean with light compression on the master bus and subtle room reverb on the drums. The guitar tone is characterized by a mid-range boost and slight crunch.
